title: JourneyBench: A Challenging One-Stop Vision-Language Understanding Benchmark of Generated Images
reasoning: JourneyBench is a technical benchmark for evaluating multimodal models on tasks such as arithmetic reasoning, VQA, and retrieval using generated images of unusual or fictional scenes. While the paper includes standard sections on ethics and societal impacts (Sections L and N), these are disclosures required for the research process and do not constitute a core component of benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning.
